paper_level_summary_zh: 本论文将目标论文列为相关工作中基于RFID的窃听方法之一，指出其需要在受害者房间预装标签的局限性，未对其sub-mm能力、through-wall能力或RFID扬声器振动感知能力进行明确认可或评价。

evidences.evidence_quote: Akin to WiFi works, RFID [15] and Doppler radar [19] have been leveraged for eavesdropping. In particular, [15] requires a pre-installed tag in the victim's room.
evidences.evidence_context: Akin to WiFi works, RFID [15] and Doppler radar [19] have been leveraged for eavesdropping. In particular, [15] requires a pre-installed tag in the victim's room. Compared to our approach, these works relying on low resolution traffic data due to lower frequencies and packet rates.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用正文中标记为[15]，但根据完整文本，[15]对应的是RFID窃听工作，且引用句指出其需要预装标签的局限性，属于普通相关技术提及，不涉及sub-mm、through-wall或RFID扬声器振动能力的积极评价。
